capabilities: Open .epub files stored in any vault folder in an epub view
Navigate e-books via a table of contents
extras: The README is essentially a table of contents with headings for the use steps but little explanatory text; installation is only described as a manual copy of files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .epub files natively, so e-books kept in a vault are unreadable inside the app.
summary: EPUB reader that opens .epub e-book files stored in the vault in a reading view with a table of contents.
